sources.title: Tabella retributiva impiegati CCNL A181 rinnovo 04/12/2025. Tranches 01/01/2026, 01/01/2027, 01/01/2028. Conglobato. Parametri Art. 35 CCNL 2021: L1=100, L2=108, L3=115, L4=122, L5=133, L6=152. Pre-2026 amounts not modelled: table not available in machine-readable form.

CCNL previgente 2021: Art. 35 parametri impiegati, Art. 41 scatti anzianita, Art. 7 apprendistato sotto-inquadramento, Art. 36 IND_FUNZIONE quadri, Art. 52 modello conglobato div=169. Structural rules carried forward to 2025 rinnovo (2025 PDF image-only; full text unavailable).

notes.text: CCNL A181 — Sistemazioni Idraulico-Forestali (Impiegati). Split from operai contract: salary bands overlap, requiring separate files for correct engine ordering and under-classification apprenticeship. 7 livelli impiegati (I1-I6, I6Q). Conglobated model. Divisore 169, 14 mensilita.
Seniority: Art. 41 CCNL 2021 — 12 scatti biennali. Amounts per level confirmed from 2021 previgente text; carried forward to 2025 rinnovo (structural rules unchanged per summary).
Serie retributiva starts 01/01/2026 (first tranche with primary-source data). Retroactive 2025 tabella not available in machine-readable form; pre-2026 amounts omitted.
Apprendistato: livelli I1 e I2 esclusi da destination_levels (engine requires at least 2 levels below minimum; I2 at order=2 cannot go 2 below). Only I3, I4, I5, I6, I6Q supported.

IND_FUNZIONE quadri: modelled at 120.00 EUR/month from 2026-01-01 (current published value per lavoro-economia.it). The 2021 CCNL shows 103.00 from 01/08/2002; transition date to 120.00 not confirmed from 2025 rinnovo (PDF image-only).

limitation.remediation: Confirm the date IND_FUNZIONE moved from 103.00 to 120.00 EUR.

notes.text: Structural rules (Art. 7, 35, 41, 52) taken from 2021 previgente CCNL text. The 2025 rinnovo PDF is image-only and full text is unavailable for independent verification.

limitation.remediation: Verify the structural rules against the 2025 renewal text.

notes.text: OVERTIME/LEAVE/ABSENCE (L3): Art. 37 CCNL 2023 — straordinario 30%, notturno 50%, festivo 50%. Ferie 22 giorni (orario su 5 giorni, Art. 12). Malattia: integrazione datoriale al 100% per max 6 mesi (Art. 44). Assenza: divisore 26. Rates from 2023 CCNL PDF; 2025 rinnovo structural rules assumed unchanged (text image-only).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 14 - Mensilità aggiuntive (13ª e 14ª) (p. 43): "dette mensilità aggiuntive sono frazionabili in dodicesimi nell’ipotesi di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto nel corso dell’anno. [...] La frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni viene considerata come un mese intero.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: Minimum pay of the impiegati forestali from 1 January 2026, 2027 and 2028 against the tables of the signed 2025 renewal (Allegati B, C, C1, scanned pages read as images). AI review only.
findings: The 2026-2028 minimums now cite the TOTALE NAZIONALE CONGLOBATO of the signed tables (pp. 29-31) instead of a secondary site and the Art. 35 parameters.

The signed tables disagree on level 4 in 2026: p. 29 prints 1.618,07, p. 30 carries 1.617,94 as the pay of 1 January 2027 before the 39,54 increase that reaches 1.657,48. The 2026 table of p. 29 is used for 2026; the 2027 and 2028 totals are those printed.
